export type Status = 'open' | 'in-progress' | 'resolved' | 'closed';

export interface Issue {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  status: Status;
  assignee: string;
  tags: string[];
  createdAt: string;
}

export function createIssue(title: string): Issue {
  const issue: Issue = {
    id: Math.max(0, ...issues.map((item) => item.id)) + 1,
    title,
    description: '',
    status: 'open',
    assignee: 'Unassigned',
    tags: [],
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  };
  issues.unshift(issue);
